correctness.rationale: The stated observable is the explicitly spatially integrated deterministic quadratic excess current, not the algebraic form factor postulated in the earlier paper. Starting from U_omega(x)=sinh((1+i)s(x-1/2))/(2sinh((1+i)s/2)), direct integration of |U_prime-1|² gives J(s)=s(sinh s+sin s)/(2(cosh s-cos s))-1; independently evaluated the integral numerically at s=0.5,1.2,2.1,4.5, matching to 1e-10. Its exact small-s series starts s^4/180 and large-s J=s/2-1+O(se^-s). Direct complex amplitude subtraction gives the submitted rational lag, hence positive normalized Q. Rescaling z=s²/λ_n produces λ_n^-3/2 Q=h(z)[s/J(s)]/405; h>0 vanishes at z endpoints, derivative sign is negative of strictly increasing polynomial z^6+30z^4+17z²-108, so unique nondegenerate z*=1.26459650688644. Boundary localization and uniform C² perturbation justify global unique high-n maximizer and both n³/n² coefficients. The high-mode statement follows only after the continuum weak-response limit, not uniformly for microscopic lattice modes.
